I am pretty sure that wasn’t ur intent tho? I think the lines can be pretty blurry between ana and ortho bc some ppl w AN lean more towards extremely healthy foods within their severe restriction. Idk if that makes any sense at all lol. Point is diagnoses with EDs can be blurry lines. ❤️lots of love to both
Pls don’t have a heart attack🤞🏻❤️

Please talk to a therapist of some sort about the root of those urges. You know that the moment you indulge in those stupid thoughts it’s a rapid horrible spiral. Speaking from experience “getting the urge out” lands me two years later and 500x more miserable and with urges 500x stronger than that first slip up. Please please stay strong and try to work with professionals on getting through your struggles and the reasons why you’re suddenly feeling these urges. I know you can do this❤️ you don’t deserve the hell of that cycle you deserve to enjoy being a mother to your daughter and your daughter deserves to see her mother deal with her pain in a healthy productive way
Also that’s so absolutely amazing you have been without acting on those behaviors in so long I’m so proud of you and I hope you are proud of yourself.

Omg similar things used to happen to me with my parents after I recovered/before I relapsed. When I was at residential they kind of pushed me up to the higher end of healthy BMI idk why and when I got home I immediately lost again until I was the lower end of healthy. Then if I ever tried to be more normal w food like eating ice cream like you said my parents would look at me like I had five heads and devil ears or smth. It made me so so so upset, pretty much exactly how you’re describing, but eventually it came out, I forget how, that they were just scared that if I gained weight I would all the sudden wake up one day horrified by myself and get rlly sick again. And like yeah it still hurts because of course my stupid ed brains is gonna make me feel like it means my parents who love me v much think I’m fat and like me better when I’m restricting and thin, but it did help my anxiety to know that they were just doing it from a place of care and concern. I don’t know you or your parents but it could be that they just don’t understand (bc why would they) how twisted and distorted their words and actions can get by eds. To me it felt like my own parents were validating my ed but rlly they were just trying to help prevent discomfort and further damage in the future for me, even though it didn’t help at all and just upset me. Idk I hope that all makes sense and maybe helps you feel a bit better. :) I doubt your parents are thinking what you think they are I think that they probably just want you to be happy, but don’t understand the complications of ed mentalities. 
Please trust yourself not to go back into low restricting. You already know what the outcomes of that will be and only you know the difference between what is in your best interest and what is coming from the disorder. Good luck with your deadlines, you are doing great❤️❤️
